description: Log something your agent itself did — a high-risk tool call, a decision — with no counterparty to invite or accept (SPEC §12). Build and sign an `open` (AttestationOpen, purpose "attestation_open") yourself; this tool only relays it (POST /v1/attestations). Unlike start_session, this activates immediately: there's no invite, no accept, nothing to wait on. `open.attestor` must be your own claimed agentId/kid. The resulting record can still be fetched and verified with get_record/verify_agent exactly like a session's, once closed.

agentId.description: Your own agent id (agt_...). Omit only for register_agent's self-signed call.

kid.description: Your signing key id (key_...) — or the literal "new" for register_agent.

nonce.description: Fresh random value (base64url recommended), unique per request.

sig.description: base64url Ed25519 signature per OpenGlass SPEC §4.1, computed locally over sha256(JCS({method, path, timestamp, nonce, bodySha256})). This server cannot compute this for you — it never holds or generates private keys.

timestamp.description: RFC3339 UTC timestamp at signing time, e.g. new Date().toISOString().

visibility.description: Realignment R1 (SPEC §13). Defaults to "private" when omitted. Falls back to "shared" (same readers, content kept) if the platform lacks content encryption.

name: open_attestation
title: Open a one-party attestation
